ctc_tags.rationale: Participants retain distinct purpose references and attention states rather than inheriting a group or machine foreground.
A shared event may become a collective question without requiring identical interpretation or urgency.

ctc_tags.domain: Technology as Tool to Think With
ctc_tags.rationale: Foreground, disclosure, consent, and shared-rule state become inspectable computational material.
Attention changes may later document inquiry development, but the schema is not itself evidence of learning.
Participants may defer, surface, and later compare different observations without machine-synchronized reflection.
Whose attention becomes shared, interruptive, or private is a power-bearing design choice.
The contribution directly models collaboration while preserving disagreement, privacy, withdrawal, and separate authorship.

ontology_tags.rationale: Several people and Turtle may influence what emerges without being normalized into one group state.
Several legitimate foregrounds and directions may remain alive simultaneously.
Shared play need not impose one synchronized agenda on all participants.
A shared room of possibilities can preserve several human purposes and attention paths.
Private foregrounds, shared rules, system decisions, and human consent remain distinct provenance classes.

emergent_tags.rationale: A shared computational environment can contain multiple legitimate attention states at once.
A participant may expose a rule or its existence without exposing the full private rationale.
The machine is explicitly barred from manufacturing or averaging a collective priority.
The contribution committed successfully while research registration, Build Log publication, and Next Edge advancement failed to close.

reconciliation_findings.reason: Registered by this recovery manifest and public Build Log repair.
Original automation omitted the daily record; recovery preserves the gap rather than pretending normal closure occurred.
No confirmed live D1 write occurred during the original cycle or this repair.

uncaptured_observations.observation: The schema records affected and consenting participants but does not yet have a deterministic hostile suite proving how active shared rules should behave when consent is incomplete, withdrawn, or contradictory.
Selective disclosure can protect privacy while making collaboration possible, but existence-only disclosure may itself reveal sensitive context in some situations.
A successful code commit without research closure is a provenance failure even when the product artifact itself is correct.

source_hunt_recovery.reason: The original September 15 automation did not persist its source hunt or deliberation. No external source claims are retroactively invented in this recovery record.

version_judgment.rationale: The plural-foreground contract is versioned research infrastructure but lacks its own deterministic hostile suite and remains outside live learner-facing collaborative behavior.
